business.what_it_does: Crisp is an AI customer support platform combining an omnichannel shared inbox, a website live chat widget, and AI Agents that companies use to centralize and automate customer conversations.
business.category: AI customer support / live chat / shared inbox platform

facts.statement: Crisp is trusted by 10,000 companies of all sizes.

provenance.quote: Trusted by 10,000 companies of all sizes

facts.statement: Every new Crisp account gets a 14-day free trial with all Crisp features and no card required.

provenance.quote: 14 days free trial — All Crisp features — No card required

facts.statement: Crisp's AI-driven Magic Replies helped Reedsy decrease average response times by five minutes.

provenance.quote: Crisp's AI-driven Magic Replies helped Reedsy decrease average response times by five minutes, enhancing customer satisfaction.

facts.statement: Decathlon trialled 5 competing products before choosing Crisp, and was surprised by the flat price paid plan for up to 20 users.

provenance.quote: We trialled 5 competing products, not realising Crisp had been developed over the years and now has been significantly developed and meets/exceeds our (above) needs. The Crisp flat price Paid plan for up to 20 users blew us away!

facts.statement: Emma centralizes all inbound queries in one place using Crisp to make operators more productive.

provenance.quote: Centralize all inbound queries in one place to make our operators more productive

facts.statement: If a website's platform or plan blocks third-party JavaScript, the Crisp chatbox cannot load until that platform allows custom scripts.

provenance.quote: If your platform does not allow third-party JavaScript, Crisp cannot load until custom scripts are supported on that platform or plan.

facts.statement: The Mini, Essentials and Plus plans each include a fixed amount of AI credits stated as an approximate number of automated conversations.

provenance.quote: AI Credits | $0 | Around 90 automated conversations $5 | Around 450 automated conversations $25 | Around 1350 automated conversations $75
Free | Forever | 2 seats included | No AI credits included

offer.free_entry: Try any plan for free for 14 days — 14 days free trial — All Crisp features — No card required

entries.claim: Decathlon uses Crisp to help customers navigate their extensive product catalog online, especially for high-investment items like fitness machines and bicycles, and gives agents instant access to customer histories via Crisp's API and integrations
entries.verbatim: Decathlon needed a platform to help customers navigate their extensive product catalog online, especially for high-investment items like fitness machines and bicycles. Crisp provides Decathlon with the tools necessary to assist customers instantly, helping to replicate the in-store experience. Through Crisp’s robust API and integrations, Decathlon agents have immediate access to customer histories, enabling quick responses that strengthen customer trust and satisfaction.

context.subject: Decathlon
context.conditions: online retail of extensive product catalog including high-investment items; via Crisp's API and integrations
context.limitations: Vendor-authored case study narrative, not a direct Decathlon quote

entries.claim: Laurent Hayoz of Decathlon says Crisp is essential in delivering an online experience that mirrors the personalized service found in stores, enabling efficient query management and quick, tailored responses
entries.verbatim: For Decathlon, Crisp is essential in delivering an online experience that mirrors the personalized service found in stores. The platform enables the team to manage customer queries efficiently and ensure quick, tailored responses.

entries.claim: Reedsy switched to Crisp from alternatives Intercom and Zendesk; Crisp enables Reedsy's support agents to access all user data instantly, streamlining conversations
entries.verbatim: Reedsy initially encountered Crisp when exploring alternatives to Intercom and Zendesk. The decision to switch was driven by Crisp’s robust, affordable feature set and the meaningful human connection established with its team. Crisp now enables Reedsy’s support agents to access all user data instantly, streamlining conversations and helping users complete their publishing journeys with confidence.

context.subject: Reedsy
context.conditions: switched from Intercom and Zendesk
context.limitations: Vendor-authored narrative, not a direct Reedsy quote

entries.claim: Emma chose Crisp for its flexibility and level of automations, allowing automation workflows to learn from previous conversations, custom data and helpdesk to provide 24/7 support
entries.verbatim: We chose Crisp from the begining because of its flexibility and level of automations it allowed. With the recent innovations in artificial intelligence, the automation workflows can now learn from previous conversations, custom data, helpdesk, etc.. It allows us to provide 24/7 support to our customers.

context.subject: Emma
context.conditions: uses automation workflows with AI learning from previous conversations, custom data, helpdesk
